_comment: Dated dispositions for branches that are deliberately not merged into an integration branch.
Same discipline as scripts/reachability/allowlist.json: every entry states a REASON and an
EXPIRY, and an expired entry is itself a blocker. A disposition is a decision with a shelf
life, not a permanent exemption — the whole point is that 'we meant to leave this here' has
to be re-affirmed rather than quietly inherited.
A dispositioned branch also becomes an ACCOUNTED REF: commits it holds count as accounted
for every other branch too. That is what collapses the 306 arbor/* pointer branches from
'unaccounted' to 'contained' — they hold nothing the feature branch does not.
